channel.description: Latest articles from Channel 7 of Detroit, Inc. (wxyz.com)

item.title: Detroit high school girls get hands-on look at careers in the skilled trades
item.description: Detroit high school girls explored skilled trades careers Thursday, as the U.S. faces a shortage of 500K workers — a number expected to hit 2M by 2030.

item.title: Long-awaited Allen Road train overpass in Woodhaven is finally moving forward
item.description: Wayne County is moving forward with a long-awaited project to build a train overpass on Allen Road near Van Horn in Woodhaven — a fix that tens of thousands have been waiting for since 2009.

item.title: Allen Park Planning Commission delays vote again on data center preliminary site approval
item.description: On Thursday night, the Allen Park Planning Commission voted to postpone making a decision on preliminary site approval for 26-megawatt data center. This is the second postponement in two months.
